connector.name: Cortex Gateway
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted federated MCP gateway: one OAuth 2.1 MCP server in front of N apps, user-level scopes.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.cortex-gateway.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image cortex-gateway:v0.2.0. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wellknownmcp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
